system.description:
You gain a +3 bonus to [Attack Power]. Treat this effect as a Combat Status.

(Fate 1): If you have reached your Limit for this skill, you may pay this cost to use it again.

A special skill that releases the magical power of the pattern that symbolizes bravery and increases the destructive power of magic and martial arts. As a member of the legal tribe, your body is engraved with powerful patterns.
